hotels.vendor_name: Golden Palm Tree Malaysia (formerly Avani Sepang Goldcoast Resort)
hotels.title: Malaysia Overwater Rooms & Villas near Kuala Lumpur with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Cocktails
hotels.description: Wake to water lapping beneath the floor and the Malacca Strait stretching to the horizon at this unique oasis. Golden Palm Tree Malaysia is a cluster of overwater villas arranged in the shape of a giant palm tree, set on Bagan Lalang Beach in Sepang and reached by a long boardwalk from the shore. Spend sun-soaked days floating in the tranquil infinity pool, spectacularly positioned over the ocean below. Start your mornings in this tropical oasis with a blissful breakfast buffet at Bila-Bila, savour Malaysian-Chinese cuisine at Sepoi-Sepoi or mix it up with bold Sichuan or Cantonese dishes at Hai Sang Lou. For those looking to unwind, rejuvenation is made easy at the onsite Lin Spa, while children get their own slice of paradise at the complimentary Tiki Tots Kids Club. When it comes time to explore, take to the river by boat to see the mangroves or embark on a tour led by the hotel's expert team. Explore the nearby Sepang International Circuit, a must for motorsport enthusiasts.

hotels.title: Ultra-Modern Kuala Lumpur Escape Moments from the Airport with Outdoor Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Moments from the Kuala Lumpur International Airport, this Mövenpick haven turns transit into tranquillity, the ideal base to put your feet up after touching down in Malaysia. Mornings at this five-star oasis begin with a spread of Western and Asian breakfast favourites, while afternoons are sweetened with Mövenpick’s signature hour of chocolate treats. When you're not out exploring Kuala Lumpur's bustling city centre, keep cool at the expansive outdoor pool, unwind with a treatment at the spa or savour a late-night plate of char kway teow delivered to your modern room. Keep up with your routine at the fitness centre, and slip seamlessly from meetings to poolside relaxation with spaces for the business traveller dotted around the hotel.
